title: Quota reform protest begins
detail: Students launched a coordinated protest demanding changes to the quota structure in government recruitment.

title: The movement spreads across universities
detail: Mobilization rapidly expanded beyond Dhaka, turning the quota issue into a countrywide student-led civic campaign.

title: Crackdowns, arrests, and attacks sharpen the conflict
detail: Participants faced police action, arrests, and assaults by pro-government actors, deepening the movement's significance beyond policy reform alone.

title: Quota policy is formally revised
detail: The movement's pressure contributed to a formal government shift on quotas for major public-service recruitment tracks later in the year.
